# asciipaper

> Live, animated, mouse-interactive ASCII wallpapers for Omarchy, Arch Linux and Wayland compositors with layer-shell (Hyprland, Sway, niri). Any HTML page becomes a desktop background on every monitor.

- Repo: https://github.com/cYoren/asciipaper
- Install: `git clone https://github.com/cYoren/asciipaper && cd asciipaper && ./install.sh`
- Use: `asciipaper set <fluid|flow|matrix|asciify|URL|file.html>`
- Write a wallpaper: one .html that loads ./lib/asciipaper.js and calls asciipaper.ascii({glsl: "vec4 cell(vec2 uv){...}"}) — GPU-rendered glyph grid with pointer/click uniforms; or plain canvas. Preview with `asciipaper preview file.html`. See skills/asciipaper/SKILL.md.
- Agent skill: `npx skills add cYoren/asciipaper`
- Bundled: offline 1:1 port of asciify.org Fluid (asciify-engine, MIT).
